values.title: Validate a compact travel coffee mug

messages.content: Validate a compact travel coffee mug for the US market. Target commuters and frequent travelers, test a $24–$34 price range, and keep the product under 350 g.

## Recorded sample result

**Recommendation: VALIDATE BEFORE COMMITTING.** The brief defines a clear use occasion, but leak resistance, cleaning effort, cup-holder fit, and price acceptance require physical and message testing before an inventory decision.

This is a deterministic English demo. No model or external API is running, and the sample findings are not current market research.

Open the richer [interview walkthrough](/demo?scenario=launch) to inspect the Launch Director, three active specialists, the deterministic preflight gate, and four sample deliverables. Switch to the Growth Experiment scenario to inspect a separate read-only analysis path.
